notes: Cue: the barman poet poem ('I am the world's last barman poet! ... The Sex On The Beach...the Schnapps made from peach! ... Bar's open!!') is Brian's, verbatim on Wikiquote, but it is performed in New York, not at the Jamaica bar. It is a real scene and the cue names no place, so it passes; a Jamaica cue would fit the venue better (see ideas). The Cocktails and Dreams pineapple line is the New York opening, also a real scene. Coughlin's Law, Coughlin's Diet and the aristocrat line are Doug's on Wikiquote. Small still captioned 'Bar tab, Jamaica' shows Brian at a thatched beach bar.

vibe.verdict: Jerk chicken, escovitch snapper and curry goat at a Jamaican beach bar with Coughlin's Law is a strong fit, but the tiki layout's Polynesian words (Pupu platters, Ring the gong, Tonight's islands) and a New York cue pull it away from Jamaica.
